label: At D2, high after a1 reaching S2 (rare), low after a2 reaching S1 or a1 reaching S1.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state==1) * (prev_reward==1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 44 is timing-dominated (high at GO, negative at D2; timing R^2 0.96). Beyond timing, the D2 value is set by the just-made choice x reached state (both observed at D2): a1->S2 (rare) raises it strongly (+0.57), a2->S1 (rare) lowers it (-0.26), a1->S1 lowers it slightly (-0.12) relative to a2->S2. So it is mainly a rare-transition signal signed by action. The free fit adds a smaller D1 effect of the last trial (lower after an unrewarded S2 trial, higher after rewarded S1), a D2 previous-reward / belief_lo term, raising dev R^2 from 0.80 to 0.88. GO is essentially unmodulated. No future variables used.

issues: The short form reproduces the claimed numbers. Test R^2 beyond timing is 0.788, equal to the 'this choice x state' reference table (0.79). The 'all observed' ceiling is 0.90. Weights: a1->S2 +0.57, a2->S1 -0.26, a1->S1 -0.12, all relative to a2->S2.

The label says 'high' and 'low', but these are relative to timing. Every D2 value is still negative in absolute terms (baseline about -0.69). The ordering is a1S2 > a2S2 > a1S1 > a2S1, so 'a rare transition, signed by action' is a fair reading.

There is a remaining but modest systematic error. At D1, the short form over-predicts after unrewarded S2 trials (a1 S2 u -0.145, a2 S2 u -0.120) and under-predicts after rewarded S1 trials (+0.05 to +0.09). The label leaves this D1 effect out, though the explanation mentions it. It accounts for most of the gap to the free fit (0.79 vs 0.87).

There is a large spread inside the a1->S2 cell at D2 (in the worst windows, actual -0.59 vs predicted -0.11, usually after prev_reward = 0). No 3-factor term captures it: swapping in (phase==D2)*(action==1)*(prev_reward==0) for the a1->S1 term scores 0.792 on test, about the same as 0.788.
No alternative third term beat the a1->S1 term in any material way. With belief_lo, prev_reward, or the D1 prev_state x prev_reward term instead, test scores were 0.72 to 0.79.
